## What's Changed
This release fixes 17 security advisories and several smaller issues.
In addition, it provides some smaller updates and improvements:
* fix build of training tool on windows with VS2022: by @zdenop in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4590
* arch,viewer: add missing <cstdlib> and <string> by @tachalorah in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4592
* Fix recursive static initialization in SIMDDetect::GetDetector() by @stweil with @Copilot in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4598
* exports GetDetector() from the tesseract DLL, so linker can resolve it. by @zdenop in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4602
* Fix two \param names that refer to the member, not the argument by @darkdi in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4594
* Add new GitHub workflow which checks commits in a pull request by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4604
* Build unit tests without training tools by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4596
* docs: update dead Tesseract training docs link by @yzxcj797 in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4605
* Fix several high and medium priority issues reported by Coverity Scan by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4597
* Fix Coverity warnings by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4606
* Avoid quadratic paragraph restart scan by @ilkecan in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4599
* Bump actions/checkout from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4607
* Fix GitHub AI findings from 'Security and quality' by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4613
* Fix inefficient empty string test in ScrollView menus by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4612
* Fix some issues reported by Coverity by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4611
* fix: prevent out-of-bounds read in UNICHAR::UTF8ToUTF32 by @SomSamantray in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4609
* fix: prevent out-of-bounds access on truncated UTF-8 strings and crafted index maps by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4617
* Avoid redundant result iterator restarts by @ilkecan in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4601
* fix: potential memory leak by @y1lan in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4622
* Avoid float overflow for unclassified-word certainty by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4630
* Reject int-mode weight matrices with zero inputs in the deserializer by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4644
* Fix position-dependent paragraph bounding box by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4632
* Reject negative/oversized class ids in legacy inttemp by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4640
* Exit child process when execvp fails by @Ramya-9353 in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4577
* Neutralise file-sourced pointers in ReadAdaptedClass before use by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4645
* Fix Devanagari font download URL by @SKSavale in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4654
* cmake: allow unit tests to use installed GoogleTest by @manduinca in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4650
* Reject malformed dimensions in GENERIC_2D_ARRAY deserialization by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4649
* ccstruct: fix leak of orphaned outline cycles in EliminateDuplicateOutlines by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4655
* Fix double-free/UAF in AppendLinePolygon for RTL PAGE XML output by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4647
* wordrec: bound seam search to prevent timeouts on degenerate input by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4656
* lstm: reject old-format WeightMatrix instead of aborting by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4657
* wordrec: add a per-pass seam search budget to bound many-word timeouts by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4659
* Reject out-of-range null_char in LSTM model load by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4642
* Harden class-id handling in the int/adaptive classifier by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4639
* Reject int-mode weight matrices with a short scale vector by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4641
* Reject a recoder whose code range exceeds the network output count by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4643
* Skip unit tests when their traineddata model is missing by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4646
* nsis: rewrite winpath helper without a fixed-size buffer by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4661
* Fix C++17 build of constexpr FCOORD operators by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4665
* Fix use-after-free in ReplaceCurrentWord with several languages by @mardgez in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4667

* Fix some compiler warnings (-Wunused-parameter) by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4570
* ci: Improve installer for windows by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4572
* Fix several issues reported by Codacy (including real bugs) by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4573
* Bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4574
* Fix crash when LSTM is missing in disabled-legacy build (#4448) by @gaurav0107 in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4563
* ci: Remove unused ilammy/setup-nasm by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4575
* autotools: Simplify Makefile rules by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4579
* Fix memory-safety issues in .traineddata deserialization by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4581
* Handle send() failures in SVNetwork::Flush by @Ramya-9353 in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4576
* Small code improvements by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4585
* doc: Add comprehensive PARAMETERS section to the tesseract man page by @stweil with @Copilot in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4526
* Fix integer overflow in LSTM Convolve and Reconfig deserialization by @stweil in https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/pull/4588

This is a new minor version of Tesseract 5.

* Improvements and fixes for continuous integration,
  autoconf and cmake builds.
* Set /Os for some 32 bit MS compilers (fixes #3769).
* Improve comments and other documentation.
* Add initial support for Intel AVX512F.
* Fix for very large PDF files on 32 bit hosts (fixes #3805).
* Fix NEON detection on FreeBSD.
* Fix regression with UZN files (fixes #3837).
* Fix calling delete[] for memory allocated by malloc in C API.
* Add an API function to init tesseract with traineddata from memory
  (fixes #3691).
* Replace direct access to Leptonica internal data structures by
  function calls and support latest releases of Leptonica.
* Replace std::regex by std::string functions (fixes issue #3830).
* Use compiled-in TESSDATA_PREFIX also on Windows (fixes #3767).
* Add new parameter 'invert_threshold', change the default threshold
  from 0.5 to 0.7 and mark parameter 'tessedit_do_invert' as deprecated.

See also list of [all changes](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/compare/5.1.0...5.2.0).

This is a new minor version of Tesseract 5.

* Handle image and line regions in output formats ALTO, hOCR and text.
* New parameter curl_timeout for curl_easy_setop.
* Build fixes and improvements.
* Catch nullptr in PageIterator::Orientation to improve robustness.
* Remove unused code.

See also list of [all changes](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/compare/5.0.1...5.1.0).

This is a bug fix release of Tesseract 5.0.

* Add SPDX-License-Identifier to public include files.
* Support redirections when running OCR on a URL.
* Lots of fixes and improvements for cmake builds.
  Distributions should use the autoconf build.
* Fix broken msys2 build with gcc 11.
* Fix parameter certainty_scale (was duplicated).
* Fix some compiler warnings and clean code.
* Correctly detect amd64 and i386 on FreeBSD.
* Add libarchive and libcurl in continuous integration actions.
* Update submodule googletest to release v1.11.0.

See also list of [all changes](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/compare/5.0.0...5.0.1).

This is the final stable release of Tesseract 5.0.0.

* Limit BCER to interval [0,1]
* Improved build process
* Cleaned code

See also list of [all changes](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/compare/5.0.0-rc3...5.0.0).

cuerpo.body:
This is a new pre-release of Tesseract 5.0.0.

It has massive changes in the public API which is a great step towards a final 5.0.0.
All unit tests pass, but because of those changes more practical experience is needed.

* the public API no longer uses proprietary data types GenericVector, STRING
* pdf.ttf is no longer needed because it is now integrated into the code

See also list of [all changes](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/compare/5.0.0-alpha-20201224...5.0.0-alpha-20201231).

cuerpo.name: 5.0.0-alpha-20201224
cuerpo.body:
This is a new pre-release of Tesseract 5.0.0.

It is considered to be production ready for end users, but nevertheless not stable because more incompatible API changes are planned.

* improved performance (also on ARM / ARM64)
* improved unit tests
* many fixes
* faster flat build with automake
* support for latest macOS (including new M1 processor)

See also list of [all changes](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/compare/5.0.0-alpha...5.0.0-alpha-20201224).

cuerpo.name: 4.1.0 Release
cuerpo.body:
* Added new renderers Alto, LSTMBox, WordStrBox.
  * Added character boxes in hOCR output.
  * Added python training scripts (experimental) as alternative shell scripts.
  * Better support AVX / AVX2 / SSE.
  * Disable OpenMP support by default (see e.g. #1171, #1081).
  * Fix for bounding box problem.
  * Implemented support for whitelist/blacklist in LSTM engine.
  * Improved cmake configuration.
  * Code modernization and improvements.
  * A lot of bug fixes...

Detailed [changelog](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract/wiki/4.0x-Changelog) is on wiki.

Windows installer can be downloaded from https://github.com/UB-Mannheim/tesseract/wiki.

cuerpo.name: 3.05.00 Release
cuerpo.body:
- Made some fine tuning to the hOCR output.
  - Added TSV as another optional output format.
  - Fixed ABI break introduced in 3.04.00 with the AnalyseLayout() method.
  - text2image tool - Enable all OpenType ligatures available in a font. This feature requires Pango 1.38 or newer.
  - Training tools - Replaced asserts with tprintf() and exit(1).
  - Fixed Cygwin compatibility.
  - Improved multipage tiff processing.
  - Improved the embedded pdf font (pdf.ttf).
  - Enable selection of OCR engine mode from command line.
  - Changed tesseract command line parameter '-psm' to '--psm'.
  - Added new C API for orientation and script detection, removed the old one.
  - Increased minimum autoconf version to 2.59.
  - Removed dead code.
  - Fixed many compiler warning.
  - Fixed memory and resource leaks.
  - Fixed some issues with the 'Cube' OCR engine. 
  - Fixed some openCL issues.
  - Added option to build Tesseract with CMake build system.
  - Implemented [CPPAN](https://github.com/cppan) support for easy Windows building.
